coverLetter.defaultText:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Please find our purchase order enclosed. For detailed information on the ordered positions, quantities and specifications, please refer to the following order or the attached document.

We kindly ask you for a written order confirmation as well as notification of the binding or expected delivery date. Should individual positions not be available as ordered, or should there be any deviations regarding price, quantity, specification or delivery date, please inform us before executing the order.

Unless we receive notice to the contrary from you, we assume that the order will be executed under the conditions stated in our purchase order.

Please quote our order number in all correspondence relating to this order.

Our General Terms and Conditions (GTC) form an integral part of our order and govern the contractual relationship. The current version is available at https://offitec.ch/agb. Conflicting or deviating terms of the supplier apply only if we have expressly agreed to them in writing.

Thank you for processing our order — we look forward to a smooth handling.

Kind regards
The OffiTec Team
